name: CTD & Bottle
line: Temperature, salinity, oxygen, nutrients and chlorophyll by depth
description: Measurements of the water column at CalCOFI stations since 1949. Bottle samples from the rosette give temperature, salinity, oxygen, nutrients, pigments and C14 at set depths; CTD casts give sensor profiles (temperature, salinity, oxygen, fluorescence and more) binned to 1 m. Two derived datasets add values computed from them, such as spice, mixed-layer depth, the chlorophyll maximum and where oxygen falls to hypoxic levels.

name: Carbonate Chemistry
line: Dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC), alkalinity and dissolved iron
description: Dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) and total alkalinity from CalCOFI Niskin bottle samples, quality-controlled with WOCE flags, and surface dissolved iron measured on CalCOFI cruises from November 2002 to July 2004.

name: Underway Weather & Surface Water
line: Weather and surface water every minute along the ship’s track
description: Surface water temperature and salinity from the ship’s thermosalinograph (TSG), with weather, recorded about once a minute continuously along the cruise track.

name: Fish Eggs & Larvae
line: Eggs and larvae from net tows and the ship’s pump
description: Fish eggs and larvae from bongo and manta net tows on CalCOFI cruises, counted by NOAA SWFSC, and egg counts (sardine, anchovy, jack mackerel, hake, squid) from the ship’s Continuous Underway Fish Egg Sampler (CUFES) since 1996. A tow with nothing in it is kept as a true zero.

name: Phytoplankton
description: Abundance and species composition of phytoplankton (385 taxonomic categories), 1996–2022, counted by inverted microscope (E. Venrick). Near-surface samples are pooled into four regions before counting, so the counts are by cruise and region, not by station.

name: Euphausiids (Krill)
line: Species and life stages from net tows
description: Krill abundance by species and life stage from CalCOFI / CCE-LTER net tows, 1951 to the present: one row per tow, species and stage. Units are provisional until the provider confirms them.

name: Zooplankton
line: Counts, carbon and size from net tows
description: Zooplankton from CalCOFI net tows, from several sources: counts and carbon for 33 higher taxa by microscopy (ZooDB, 1951–2021), abundance, carbon and size from ZooScan imaging (2005 to the present), spiny lobster larvae (1951–2008), Dungeness crab megalopae examined for CDFW, and the SIO Pelagic Invertebrate Collection’s register of tows.

name: Picoplankton & Bacteria
description: Prochlorococcus, Synechococcus, picoeukaryotes and heterotrophic bacteria counted by flow cytometry, 2004–2023 (ongoing), from seawater at 3–8 depths per station on CCE-CalCOFI Augmented cruises.

name: Seabirds & Marine Mammals
description: Seabird and marine mammal counts along CalCOFI (and NMFS, CPR) cruise transects since 1987, with the survey effort behind them.

name: Mesopelagic Fish
description: Counts of 90 named mesopelagic fish species from midwater (MOHT) trawls on 7 CalCOFI cruises, 2010–2012, all on RV New Horizon.

name: Genomics & eDNA
description: Vertebrate eDNA from water filters collected on the October 2022 CalCOFI cruise: whales and dolphins from one assay, fish from another (12S MiFish). Read counts are a rough signal, not abundance, and only detections are published.
